text: Refunds are available for thirty days after delivery. An order cancelled before delivery is refunded in full.
Report a damaged item within fourteen days with a photograph. Damaged items are replaced or refunded at the customer's choice.
Standard delivery arrives in three to five working days. Express delivery arrives the next working day when ordered before 6pm.
Refunds return to the original payment method and take three to five working days to appear.
A tracking reference is issued when an order is dispatched and updates every twenty four hours in transit.
An address can be changed until the order is dispatched. After dispatch the parcel must be redirected through the carrier.
